mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.analyst_portfolio_snapshots (snapshot_at, client_id, instrument_type, cash_balance, holdings_value, missing_prices) SELECT #{timestamp}, c.client_id, COALESCE(t.instrumenttype, 'Other'), c.cash_balance, COALESCE(SUM(h.quantity_shares * mp.current_price), 0), SUM(CASE WHEN h.quantity_shares IS NOT NULL AND h.quantity_shares != 0 AND mp.current_price IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM public.clients c LEFT JOIN public.holdings h ON h.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN public.instruments i ON i.instrument_id = h.instrument_id LEFT JOIN public.instrument_type t ON t.instrumenttype_id = i.instrumenttype_id LEFT JOIN public.market_prices mp ON mp.symbol = i.symbol WHERE c.is_admin IS NOT TRUE AND c.is_analyst IS NOT TRUE GROUP BY c.client_id, c.cash_balance, COALESCE(t.instrumenttype, 'Other')
mapper.sql:
FROM public.analyst_portfolio_snapshots s JOIN public.clients c ON c.client_id = s.client_id WHERE c.is_admin IS NOT TRUE AND c.is_analyst IS NOT TRUE
AND s.client_id IN #{id}
